en.stem: In a scholarship test, a candidate scored 35% marks and was short of passing by 70 marks. Another candidate scored 55% marks and exceeded the pass mark by 70 marks. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
Total marks gap:
70 + 70
= 140

Percentage gap:
55 - 35
= 20%

Maximum marks are:
140 × 100 / 20
= 700

Maximum marks = 700

en.stem: In an income comparison, A's income is 40% more than B's income. B's income is 50% less than C's income. Find by what percent A's income is more or less than C's income.
en.explanation:
Assume C's income = 100.
Since B is 50% less than C, B = 100 x 50 / 100 = 50.
Since A is 40% more than B, A = 50 x 140 / 100 = 70.
Compared with C = 100, A is 30% less.

hi.stem: A की आय B से 40% अधिक है। B की आय C से 50% कम है। A की आय C से कितने प्रतिशत अधिक या कम है?

pa.stem: A ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ B ਨਾਲੋਂ 40% ਵੱਧ ਹੈ। B ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ C ਨਾਲੋਂ 50% ਘੱਟ ਹੈ। A ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ C ਨਾਲੋਂ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਵੱਧ ਜਾਂ ਘੱਟ ਹੈ?
pa.explanation:
ਮੰਨ ਲਓ C ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ = 100।
B, C ਨਾਲੋਂ 50% ਘੱਟ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ B = 100 x 50 / 100 = 50।
A, B ਨਾਲੋਂ 40% ਵੱਧ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ A = 50 x 140 / 100 = 70।
C = 100 ਨਾਲ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੇ A 30% ਘੱਟ ਹੈ।

en.stem: In a local body election, 60% of the registered voters cast their votes. Out of these, 20% votes were invalid. The winning candidate got 60% of the valid votes and won by 18000 votes. Find the number of registered voters.
en.explanation:
Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
60 - 40
= 20%
Effective valid votes:
18000 × 100 / 20
= 90000
Votes polled are:
90000 × 100 / 80
= 112500
Registered voters are:
112500 × 100 / 60
= 187500
Registered voters = 187500

en.stem: In a recruitment exam, a candidate first scored 40% marks. After adding a bonus of 5%, the score was still short of the pass mark by 60 marks. The pass mark was 50%. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
After adding the bonus:
Adjusted score =
40 + 5
= 45
Required percentage gap:
50 - 45
= 5%
Maximum marks are:
60 × 100 / 5
= 1200
Thus, maximum marks = 1200

en.stem: In an urban-rural population report, the population was 60000. It increased by 15%. In addition, people equal to 2% of the original population migrated in. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Population after increase:
60000 x 115 / 100
= 69000
Population added by migration:
60000 × 2 / 100
= 1200
Final population after migration:
69000 + 1200
= 70200
Final population = 70200

en.stem: In an election report, the winning candidate got 52% of the votes and candidate C got 20%. The winning candidate defeated candidate B by 12000 votes. Find the total number of votes.
en.explanation:
Remaining candidate's vote share:
Votes remaining for other candidates =
100 - 52 - 20
= 28
Winning margin:
Remaining vote share =
52 - 28
= 24%
Total votes are:
12000 × 100 / 24
= 50000

en.stem: In a recruitment exam, a candidate scored 35% marks and was short of passing by 40 marks. Another candidate scored 65% marks and exceeded the pass mark by 20 marks. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
Total marks gap:
40 + 20
= 60
Percentage gap:
65 - 35
= 30%
Maximum marks are:
60 × 100 / 30
= 200
Hence, maximum marks in the test = 200

en.stem: According to a census report, the population was 220000. It increased by 15%. In addition, people equal to 5% of the original population migrated in. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Population after increase:
220000 x 115 / 100
= 253000
Population added by migration:
220000 × 5 / 100
= 11000
Final population after migration:
253000 + 11000
= 264000
Accordingly, final population = 264000

204 × 100 / 17

en.stem: In a migration report, the total population was 200000. Males were 60% and females were the rest. The male population increased by 25%, while the female population decreased by 5%. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Male population:
200000 × 60 / 100
= 120000

Female population:
200000 - 120000
= 80000

Male population after growth:
120000 × (100 + 25) / 100
= 150000

Female population after reduction:
Female population after decrease =
80000 × ( 100 - 5 ) / 100
= 76000

Final population:
150000 + 76000
= 226000

Final population = 226000

en.stem: In a district population survey, the total population was 300000. Males were 45% and females were the rest. The male population increased by 40%, while the female population decreased by 5%. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Male population:
300000 × 45 / 100
= 135000
Female population:
300000 - 135000
= 165000
Male population after growth:
135000 × (100 + 40) / 100
= 189000
Female population after reduction:
Female population after decrease =
165000 × ( 100 - 5 ) / 100
= 156750
Final population:
189000 + 156750
= 345750
Final population = 345750

en.stem: In a screening test, a candidate first scored 35% marks. After adding a bonus of 20%, the score was still short of the pass mark by 50 marks. The pass mark was 60%. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
After adding the bonus:
Adjusted score =
35 + 20
= 55

Required percentage gap:
60 - 55
= 5%

Maximum marks are:
50 × 100 / 5
= 1000

Hence, maximum marks in the test = 1000

en.stem: In a municipal election, 60% of the registered voters cast their votes. Out of these, 20% votes were invalid. The winning candidate got 55% of the valid votes and won by 21000 votes. Find the number of registered voters.
en.explanation:
Margin percentage =
55 - 45
= 10%
Effective valid votes =
21000 × 100 / 10
= 210000
Votes polled =
210000 × 100 / 80
= 262500
Registered voters =
262500 × 100 / 60
= 437500
Registered voters = 437500

300 × 100 / 30
= 1000
Maximum marks = 1000

en.stem: In a district population survey, the population was 80000. It increased by 15%. In addition, people equal to 2% of the original population migrated in. Find the final population.

Population after increase:
80000 x 115 / 100
= 92000
Population added by migration:
80000 × 2 / 100
= 1600
Final population after migration:
92000 + 1600
= 93600
Accordingly, final population = 93600

60 - 16

Total votes are:
39600 × 100 / 44
= 90000

en.stem: In an election report, 80% of the registered voters cast their votes. Out of these, 10% votes were invalid. The winning candidate got 55% of the valid votes and won by 27000 votes. Find the number of registered voters.
en.explanation:
Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
55 - 45
= 10%

Effective valid votes:
27000 × 100 / 10
= 270000

Votes polled are:
270000 × 100 / 90
= 300000

Registered voters are:
300000 × 100 / 80
= 375000

Registered voters = 375000

55 - 45

50 × 100 / 10
= 500

en.stem: In an urban-rural population report, the population was 140000. It increased by 10%. In addition, people equal to 4% of the original population migrated in. Find the final population.

= 154000
Population added by migration:
140000 × 4 / 100
= 5600
Final population after migration:
154000 + 5600
= 159600
Hence, final population = 159600

75 - 40
= 35%

70 × 100 / 35
= 200
Thus, maximum marks = 200

en.stem: In a qualifying examination, a candidate first scored 40% marks. After adding a bonus of 15%, the score was still short of the pass mark by 100 marks. The pass mark was 65%. Find the maximum marks.

After adding the bonus:

40 + 15
= 55
Required percentage gap:
65 - 55
= 10%
Maximum marks are:
100 × 100 / 10
= 1000

en.stem: In a recruitment exam, 40% of the paper has been evaluated. A student scored 50% of those marks. To secure 33% overall, the student still needs 26 marks. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
Marks already secured:
40 × 50 / 100
= 20
Required percentage gap:
33 - 20
= 13%
Maximum marks are:
26 × 100 / 13
= 200
Maximum marks = 200

en.stem: In an urban-rural population report, the total population was 300000. Males were 60% and females were the rest. The male population increased by 25%, while the female population decreased by 8%. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Male population:
300000 × 60 / 100
= 180000

Female population:
300000 - 180000
= 120000

Male population after growth:
180000 × (100 + 25) / 100
= 225000

Female population after reduction:
Female population after decrease =
120000 × ( 100 - 8 ) / 100
= 110400

Final population:
225000 + 110400
= 335400

Accordingly, final population = 335400

Votes remaining for other candidates =
100 - 54 - 12
= 34

Winning margin:
Remaining vote share =
54 - 34
= 20%

Total votes are:
24000 × 100 / 20
= 120000

Therefore, total votes = 120000

en.stem: In a qualifying examination, 50% of the paper has been evaluated. A student scored 50% of those marks. To secure 38% overall, the student still needs 39 marks. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
Marks already secured:
50 × 50 / 100
= 25
Required percentage gap:
38 - 25
= 13%
Maximum marks are:
39 × 100 / 13
= 300
Hence, maximum marks in the test = 300

en.stem: In an urban-rural population report, the total population was 400000. Males were 45% and females were the rest. The male population increased by 40%, while the female population decreased by 8%. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Male population:
400000 × 45 / 100
= 180000
Female population:
400000 - 180000
= 220000
Male population after growth:
180000 × (100 + 40) / 100
= 252000
Female population after reduction:
Female population after decrease =
220000 × ( 100 - 8 ) / 100
= 202400
Final population:
252000 + 202400
= 454400
Hence, final population = 454400

en.stem: Comparing the listed incomes, A's income is 25% more than B's income. B's income is 20% less than C's income. Find by what percent A's income is more or less than C's income.
en.explanation:
Assume C's income = 100.
Since B is 20% less than C, B = 100 x 80 / 100 = 80.
Since A is 25% more than B, A = 80 x 125 / 100 = 100.
Compared with C = 100, A is 0% more.

35 + 20

65 - 55
= 10%
Maximum marks are:
130 × 100 / 10
= 1300

en.stem: According to a census report, the population was 300000. It increased by 10%. In addition, people equal to 8% of the original population migrated in. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Population after increase =
300000 x 110 / 100
= 330000
Population added by migration =
300000 × 8 / 100
= 24000
Final population after migration =
330000 + 24000
= 354000
Accordingly, final population = 354000

en.stem: For the given income comparison, A's income is 40% more than B's income. B's income is 20% less than C's income. Find by what percent A's income is more or less than C's income.
en.explanation:
Assume C's income = 100.
Since B is 20% less than C, B = 100 x 80 / 100 = 80.
Since A is 40% more than B, A = 80 x 140 / 100 = 112.
Compared with C = 100, A is 12% more.

hi.stem: A की आय B से 40% अधिक है। B की आय C से 20% कम है। A की आय C से कितने प्रतिशत अधिक या कम है?

pa.stem: A ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ B ਨਾਲੋਂ 40% ਵੱਧ ਹੈ। B ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ C ਨਾਲੋਂ 20% ਘੱਟ ਹੈ। A ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ C ਨਾਲੋਂ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਵੱਧ ਜਾਂ ਘੱਟ ਹੈ?
pa.explanation:

B, C ਨਾਲੋਂ 20% ਘੱਟ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ B = 100 x 80 / 100 = 80।
A, B ਨਾਲੋਂ 40% ਵੱਧ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ A = 80 x 140 / 100 = 112।
C = 100 ਨਾਲ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੇ A 12% ਵੱਧ ਹੈ।

en.stem: In a screening test, a candidate scored 40% marks and was short of passing by 150 marks. Another candidate scored 75% marks and exceeded the pass mark by 200 marks. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
Total marks gap:
150 + 200
= 350
Percentage gap:
75 - 40
= 35%
Maximum marks are:
350 × 100 / 35
= 1000
Maximum marks = 1000

en.stem: Comparing the listed incomes, A's income is 25% more than B's income. B's income is 40% less than C's income. Find by what percent A's income is more or less than C's income.
en.explanation:
Assume C's income = 100.
Since B is 40% less than C, B = 100 x 60 / 100 = 60.
Since A is 25% more than B, A = 60 x 125 / 100 = 75.
Compared with C = 100, A is 25% less.

A, B ਨਾਲੋਂ 25% ਵੱਧ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ A = 60 x 125 / 100 = 75।

en.stem: In a municipal election, 80% of the registered voters cast their votes. Out of these, 10% votes were invalid. The winning candidate got 68% of the valid votes and won by 32400 votes. Find the number of registered voters.
en.explanation:
Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
68 - 32
= 36%
Effective valid votes:
32400 × 100 / 36
= 90000
Votes polled are:
90000 × 100 / 90
= 100000
Registered voters are:
100000 × 100 / 80
= 125000
Registered voters = 125000

en.stem: In an urban-rural population report, the population was 100000. It increased by 15%. In addition, people equal to 2% of the original population migrated in. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Population after increase:
100000 x 115 / 100
= 115000
Population added by migration:
100000 × 2 / 100
= 2000
Final population after migration:
115000 + 2000
= 117000
Hence, final population = 117000

en.stem: In an income comparison, A's income is 40% more than B's income. B's income is 50% less than C's income. Find by what percent A's income is more or less than C's income.
en.explanation:
Assume C's income = 100.
Since B is 50% less than C, B = 100 x 50 / 100 = 50.
Since A is 40% more than B, A = 50 x 140 / 100 = 70.
Compared with C = 100, A is 30% less.

en.stem: In a recruitment exam, 60% of the paper has been evaluated. A student scored 70% of those marks. To secure 55% overall, the student still needs 130 marks. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
Marks already secured:
60 × 70 / 100
= 42
Required percentage gap:
55 - 42
= 13%
Maximum marks are:
130 × 100 / 13
= 1000

en.stem: In an election report, 60% of the registered voters cast their votes. Out of these, 20% votes were invalid. The winning candidate got $62\frac{1}{2}\%$ of the valid votes and won by 52500 votes. Find the number of registered voters.
en.explanation:
Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
62.5 - 37.5
= 25%
Effective valid votes:
52500 × 100 / 25
= 210000
Votes polled are:
210000 × 100 / 80
= 262500
Registered voters are:
262500 × 100 / 60
= 437500
Registered voters = 437500

100 × 100 / 20
= 500

en.stem: In a recruitment exam, a candidate first scored 40% marks. After adding a bonus of 15%, the score was still short of the pass mark by 195 marks. The pass mark was 70%. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
After adding the bonus:
Adjusted score =
40 + 15
= 55
Required percentage gap:
70 - 55
= 15%
Maximum marks are:
195 × 100 / 15
= 1300
Hence, maximum marks in the test = 1300

= 13000

299000 + 13000
= 312000

en.stem: A's income is 25% more than B's income. B's income is 50% less than C's income. Find by what percent A's income is more or less than C's income.
en.explanation:
Assume C's income = 100.
Since B is 50% less than C, B = 100 x 50 / 100 = 50.
Since A is 25% more than B, A = 50 x 125 / 100 = 62.5.
Compared with C = 100, A is 37.5% less.

Remaining candidate's vote share:
Votes remaining for other candidates =
100 - 60 - 24
= 16
Winning margin:
Remaining vote share =
60 - 16
= 44%
Total votes are:
66000 × 100 / 44
= 150000
Therefore, total votes = 150000

en.stem: In an urban-rural population report, the total population was 400000. Males were 60% and females were the rest. The male population increased by 25%, while the female population decreased by 12%. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Male population =
400000 × 60 / 100
= 240000
Female population =
400000 - 240000
= 160000
Male population after growth =
240000 × (100 + 25) / 100
= 300000
Female population after decrease =
160000 × ( 100 - 12 ) / 100
= 140800
Final population =
300000 + 140800
= 440800
Accordingly, final population = 440800

en.stem: A's income is 40% more than B's income. B's income is 20% less than C's income. Find by what percent A's income is more or less than C's income.
en.explanation:
Assume C's income = 100.
Since B is 20% less than C, B = 100 x 80 / 100 = 80.
Since A is 40% more than B, A = 80 x 140 / 100 = 112.
Compared with C = 100, A is 12% more.

pa.stem: A ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ B ਨਾਲੋਂ 40% ਵੱਧ ਹੈ। B ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ C ਨਾਲੋਂ 20% ਘੱਟ ਹੈ। A ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ C ਨਾਲੋਂ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਵੱਧ ਜਾਂ ਘੱਟ ਹੈ?
pa.explanation:
ਮੰਨ ਲਓ C ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ = 100।
B, C ਨਾਲੋਂ 20% ਘੱਟ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ B = 100 x 80 / 100 = 80।
A, B ਨਾਲੋਂ 40% ਵੱਧ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ A = 80 x 140 / 100 = 112।
C = 100 ਨਾਲ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੇ A 12% ਵੱਧ ਹੈ।

en.stem: In a local body election, 80% of the registered voters cast their votes. Out of these, 10% votes were invalid. The winning candidate got $62\frac{1}{2}\%$ of the valid votes and won by 67500 votes. Find the number of registered voters.
en.explanation:
Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
62.5 - 37.5
= 25%
Effective valid votes:
67500 × 100 / 25
= 270000
Votes polled are:
270000 × 100 / 90
= 300000
Registered voters are:
300000 × 100 / 80
= 375000
Registered voters = 375000

en.stem: In a district population survey, the population was 20000. It increased by 10%. In addition, people equal to 8% of the original population migrated in. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Population after increase:
20000 x 110 / 100
= 22000
Population added by migration:
20000 × 8 / 100
= 1600
Final population after migration:
22000 + 1600
= 23600
Hence, final population = 23600

en.stem: In a scholarship test, a candidate scored 40% marks and was short of passing by 260 marks. Another candidate scored 70% marks and exceeded the pass mark by 130 marks. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
Total marks gap =
260 + 130
= 390
Percentage gap =
70 - 40
= 30%
Maximum marks =
390 × 100 / 30
= 1300
Hence, maximum marks in the test = 1300

en.stem: Comparing the listed incomes, A's income is 40% more than B's income. B's income is 40% less than C's income. Find by what percent A's income is more or less than C's income.
en.explanation:
Assume C's income = 100.
Since B is 40% less than C, B = 100 x 60 / 100 = 60.
Since A is 40% more than B, A = 60 x 140 / 100 = 84.
Compared with C = 100, A is 16% less.

hi.stem: A की आय B से 40% अधिक है। B की आय C से 40% कम है। A की आय C से कितने प्रतिशत अधिक या कम है?

pa.stem: A ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ B ਨਾਲੋਂ 40% ਵੱਧ ਹੈ। B ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ C ਨਾਲੋਂ 40% ਘੱਟ ਹੈ। A ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ C ਨਾਲੋਂ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਵੱਧ ਜਾਂ ਘੱਟ ਹੈ?
pa.explanation:
ਮੰਨ ਲਓ C ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ = 100।
B, C ਨਾਲੋਂ 40% ਘੱਟ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ B = 100 x 60 / 100 = 60।
A, B ਨਾਲੋਂ 40% ਵੱਧ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ A = 60 x 140 / 100 = 84।
C = 100 ਨਾਲ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੇ A 16% ਘੱਟ ਹੈ।

en.stem: During a constituency election, 60% of the registered voters cast their votes. Out of these, 20% votes were invalid. The winning candidate got 58% of the valid votes and won by 14400 votes. Find the number of registered voters.
en.explanation:
Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
58 - 42
= 16%

Effective valid votes:
14400 × 100 / 16
= 90000

Votes polled are:
90000 × 100 / 80
= 112500

Registered voters are:
112500 × 100 / 60
= 187500

Registered voters = 187500

en.stem: In a recruitment exam, a candidate first scored 40% marks. After adding a bonus of 5%, the score was still short of the pass mark by 40 marks. The pass mark was 50%. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
After adding the bonus:
Adjusted score =
40 + 5
= 45

Required percentage gap:
50 - 45
= 5%

Maximum marks are:
40 × 100 / 5
= 800

Hence, maximum marks in the test = 800

en.stem: During a constituency election, the winning candidate got 52% of the votes and candidate C got 20%. The winning candidate defeated candidate B by 40800 votes. Find the total number of votes.
en.explanation:
Remaining candidate's vote share:
Votes remaining for other candidates =
100 - 52 - 20
= 28
Winning margin:
Remaining vote share =
52 - 28
= 24%
Total votes are:
40800 × 100 / 24
= 170000
Therefore, total votes = 170000

Winning margin:
Remaining vote share =
54 - 34

Total votes are:
36000 × 100 / 20
= 180000
Total votes = 180000

en.stem: In a screening test, 50% of the paper has been evaluated. A student scored 70% of those marks. To secure 58% overall, the student still needs 322 marks. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
Marks already secured:
50 × 70 / 100
= 35
Required percentage gap:
58 - 35
= 23%
Maximum marks are:
322 × 100 / 23
= 1400
Maximum marks = 1400

300000 × 65 / 100
= 195000

en.stem: In a qualifying examination, a candidate first scored 35% marks. After adding a bonus of 10%, the score was still short of the pass mark by 55 marks. The pass mark was 50%. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
After adding the bonus:
Adjusted score =
35 + 10
= 45

Required percentage gap:
50 - 45
= 5%

Maximum marks are:
55 × 100 / 5
= 1100

Hence, maximum marks in the test = 1100

en.stem: In an urban-rural population report, the population was 180000. It increased by 10%. In addition, people equal to 4% of the original population migrated in. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Population after increase:
180000 x 110 / 100
= 198000

Population added by migration:
180000 × 4 / 100
= 7200

Final population after migration:
198000 + 7200
= 205200

Final population = 205200
